item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We are certain: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. People will set its boundaries, govern its use, and retain the power to modify or shut it down.

2. Superintelligent AI will not take humanity’s future out of human hands. If it is developed within the next 20 years, we will control how it operates, what it can access, and where it can be used.

3. We will remain in charge of AI. Rigorous safeguards, enforceable rules, and accountable oversight will ensure that any superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years stays fully under human control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will determine the rules, limits, access, and purposes that govern these systems. Human institutions will retain the authority to test, monitor, constrain, modify, and shut them down. Technical safeguards, accountable oversight, and enforceable standards will keep decisions in human hands. Superintelligence will not displace human agency; it will operate within boundaries people establish and maintain. As development advances, we will insist on rigorous protections and democratic accountability at every stage. The future of AI will be shaped by human choices, and humanity will remain firmly in charge.
